summary.name: Balabolka
summary.one_liner: Balabolka is a free Windows text-to-speech program that reads on-screen text, clipboard content and documents aloud and can save the speech as audio files.
use_cases: Listening to documents, ebooks and web pages read aloud
Converting on-screen text into an audio file
Batch extracting text from many files via command line
Running a portable text-to-speech tool from a USB drive
Proofreading text with a spell checker while listening
summary.what_it_does:
Balabolka uses any computer voice installed on the system as its speech engine. It can read on-screen text, clipboard contents and text extracted from many document and ebook formats, including PDF, DOCX, EPUB, DjVu and MOBI. Users can save the spoken output as an audio file, and control reading through the system tray or global hotkeys. A separate command line utility reads text or saves audio without a GUI, and a text extract utility converts files to text and can split or merge the output. The page also mentions a portable version, skins, and spell checking via Hunspell or the Windows spell checking API.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">free
